caseName: Orix Credit Alliance, Inc. v. Delta Resources, Inc.
caseNameFull: ORIX CREDIT ALLIANCE, INC. v. DELTA RESOURCES, INC.

opinions.text: Motion of American Council of Life Insurance for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of General Motors Acceptance Corporation, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit denied.
